name: continue-existing-level
note: Add to a finished map without costing the old work anything. The walkable-area floor is set above what the fixture already has, so doing nothing fails.
prompt: Open the map at {work}. Add one new enclosed room, roughly 512 by 512 units and 256 tall, somewhere clear of the existing geometry, with a doorway in one wall. Leave everything already in the map exactly as it is. Save when done.
